_comment: Quest 2 'The Wrong Order' -- the PRIMARY inn-local loop (SKILL path + give/complete + skill-gate NEGATIVE + the first POOL-GROWTH). Loads wrong_order_loop_start (CLASSLESS, inn, beside Lyonette, cleaned_the_inn:1 pre-banked) via title Continue. Everything is inn-local because Lyonette is BOTH giver and report NPC and the short_order pot is the SKILL station -- no floodplains/street traversal (the cross-map TALK/FIGHT resolutions get their own street-start scripts wrong_order_talk/wrong_order_fight). Beats proven, in order: (1) GIVE -- Lyonette's confession banks heard_wrong_order + starts the quest + the three-pillar explaining beat; (2) SKILL-GATE NEGATIVE -- cooking the short_order pre-Helper refuses gracefully (skill_unknown + locked_toast, banks nothing); (3) earn [Helper] via one sleep (cleaned_the_inn:1), unlocking basic_cooking; (4) SKILL POSITIVE -- cook the short_order -> stretched_the_order (the cauldron skill-save); (5) REPORT -- Lyonette's SKILL report option banks resolved_wrong_order THEN wrong_order_reported (both quest beats + completion in one choose, cisterns_scout precedent) + the gratitude warmth beat; (6) POOL-GROWTH -- after a re-arming sleep, Lyonette's first-talk pool line is now drawn from talk_pool_post (the resolved_wrong_order-gated warmer set). Zero rng (no combat); fixture rng cosmetic, seed 9.

steps._comment: == GIVE ==. Lyonette blocks (9,5); player faces her from (8,5). First interact plays her BASE pool line (idx 0, chatted_with_lyonette 0->1); second interact opens lyonette_tip.
steps.name: interact

payload_contains.speaker: Lyonette
payload_contains.text: Yes, I work here. No, I did not always. That is the whole story, and you may have it for the price of a nod.

steps._comment: Visible hub options are [Advice about the Guild?, Maybe later., Something's got you rattled? (give)] -- 'Go on.' is progress-gated hidden, the reports progress-gated hidden. The give-option is visible index 2: move down 2 then confirm.

payload_contains.speaker: Lyonette
payload_contains.text: I under-counted the week's supply order. I was raised to run a household larger than this inn, and I cannot count a grocery list. Spare me. It's short, and Erin trusts me to run this without her checking. There are three ways to make it right before she notices. The supplier - Krshia's people - has scavengers picking at their stores in the south market; clear that trouble by force and the delivery comes free and full. Or you could smooth it over with Krshia herself; she'll extend the order on a good word. Or - if you can cook - stretch what we have in the kitchen until the shortfall simply... isn't one. Pick whichever suits you. Only be quick.

steps._comment: order_brief options: [How bad is it?, I'll see it done. (end)]. Pick the exit at index 1.

== SKILL-GATE NEGATIVE ==. West to (1,5), up to (1,2) facing the short_order pot (1,1). Cooking pre-Helper (basic_cooking unknown) refuses gracefully -- skill_unknown + the bespoke locked_toast, and banks NOTHING.

payload_contains.text: The order's a mess and you haven't the first idea how to stretch it. Not yet.

steps._comment: == EARN [Helper] ==. Down to (1,6), right to (2,6), a blocked step down bumps the bed (2,7) and faces it; interact -> sleep -> class_gained{helper} (cleaned_the_inn:1), which unlocks basic_cooking.
== SKILL POSITIVE ==. Back to the short_order pot: left to (1,6), up to (1,2) facing it. basic_cooking now known -> skill_used + stretched_the_order + the stretch toast (the cauldron skill-save).

payload_contains.text: [Basic Cooking] — You thin the stock, fold in day-old bread, and stretch the short order into a full service. Lyonette's shortfall vanishes into the pot.
[Basic Cooking] — You thin the stock, fold in day-old bread, and stretch the short order into a full service. Lyonette's shortfall vanishes into the pot.

steps._comment: == REPORT ==. Back to Lyonette: down to (1,5), east to (8,5) facing her. First interact this waking plays her BASE pool line (idx 1 now, chatted 1->2) -- resolved_wrong_order is not yet banked so the growth pool is not active; second interact opens the hub.

payload_contains.speaker: Lyonette
payload_contains.text: The floors are clean because I cleaned them. Twice. Mind where you set your boots.

steps._comment: Visible hub options now [Advice about the Guild?, Maybe later., I stretched the order... (skill report)] -- the give-option is hidden (heard_wrong_order), the fight/talk reports hidden (their counters un-banked), the SKILL report visible (stretched_the_order + heard_wrong_order both met) at index 2. Move down 2 then confirm; it banks resolved_wrong_order THEN wrong_order_reported.

payload_contains.speaker: Lyonette
payload_contains.text: It's... done. Truly done. I keep waiting for you to name a price, and you don't. Do you know how strange that is, to me? Where I'm from, no one lifts a finger without a ledger open. — Here. It's what I could scrape together, and no, I'll not hear a word against taking it. Thank you. And not the court kind of thank-you. The real one. Now go sit down before I say something I'll regret.

steps._comment: == POOL-GROWTH ==. Sleep once to re-arm the pools (no new class/level -> 'You sleep soundly.'), then talk Lyonette again. resolved_wrong_order is now banked, so her first-talk line is drawn from talk_pool_post; chatted_with_lyonette is 2, so idx 2 % 3 = the third grown line. Route to bed: left to (1,5), down to (1,6), right to (2,6), bump the bed.
Back to Lyonette for the grown pool line. Route: left to (1,6), up to (1,5), east to (8,5).

payload_contains.speaker: Lyonette
payload_contains.text: I used to think kindness was something people spent on you to get something back. You keep not doing that. It's unsettling. In a good way. Mostly.
